habitat: Flocks near rivers with mud banks, where it nests.
summary: A common resident. White forehead and upper throat, red lower throat, cinnamon nape and breast, green back, wings and upper tail, and a blue belly to a dark blue vent. The call is a querulous quirk and other similar sounds. The Kemp code RB was left unchanged.

sources.title: Kemp A.C., Herholdt J.J., Whyte I. & Harrison J. (2001). Birds of the two largest national parks in South Africa: a method to generate estimates of population size for all species and assess their conservation ecology. S. Afr. J. Sci. 97: 393–403.

population.notes: Kemp et al. 2001 order-of-magnitude threshold 2^13=8192 mature individuals (resident breeder); paper interval half–double → 4096–16384.

sources.title: Kemp A.C., Herholdt J.J., Whyte I. & Harrison J. (2001). Birds of the two largest national parks in South Africa: a method to generate estimates of population size for all species and assess their conservation ecology. S. Afr. J. Sci. 97: 393–403.

head.pattern: White forehead and chin, white upper throat, red lower throat, cinnamon nape.

upperparts.pattern: Back, wings and upper tail green.

underparts.pattern: Cinnamon breast. Belly to vent blue. The description says the vent is dark blue.

calls.description: A querulous quirk and other similar sounds. Grade A call from near Skukuza, Kruger Park. The filename is XC1149412-20260519_KNP_AKaramitsos_XA60_A027C058_26051986_SLE_1000HP_-3dB_Bee-eater.mp3. It says Bee-eater and includes -3dB, and it does not name White-fronted.
